test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pugnacious
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Truculent**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pugnacious** means **a person who is quick to fight or argue**.

 
 
• Example - ***No one like Martin because he is pugnacious***.
 
 
 
• **Truculent** means **a person who is aggressive and defiant**.
 
 
• Example - ***Mark is fighting again, he is truculent***.
 
 
 
• Both pugnacious and truculent define a person who is aggressive and looking to fight or argue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Succulent** means **juicy or soft**.

 
 
• Example - ***Mariam hates succulent dishes***.
 
 
 
• **Germane** means **related or connected**
 
 
• Example - ***Historical monuments are germane to this topic.***
 
 
 
• **Sagacious** means **clever or intelligent**
 
 
• Example - ***Sam knows how to deal with tough situations, he is sagacious.***
